description.value:
A specialty candy of Penacony, each piece concealing a unique filling. Some compare it to life, as you will never know its taste until you try it yourself.

"This one is spicy!"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. At the start of each affected creature's turn roll 1d4: lose proficiency bonus hit points, regain proficiency bonus hit points, lose 5 Energy, or regain 5 Energy. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, all allies may consume or restore Energy or HP at the beginning of each turn for the next battle.
